pattern_explanation: Turkish borrowed many scientific and academic words from European languages, so some Turkish forms look almost identical to English words. Those look-alike forms do not always keep the English meaning, so learners should check the sense before reusing them.
false_friend_warning: Turkish speakers often assume that a Turkish word resembling 'sympathetic' means the same thing, but that Turkish word means 'likeable' or 'pleasant', so 'sympathetic' is a false friend here and should not be used to translate it.
